Name: DE-TimeSheetsCount
Description: Gets the count of time sheets for the filters provided.
Statement:
select	count(*) as [Count]
from	Timesheet tim
            left join JobLookup job on job.Id = tim.Deliverable
            left join ProjectLookup prj on prj.Id = tim.Project or prj.Id = job.Project
where   (@From is null or tim.Date >= @From) and
        (@To is null or tim.Date <= @To) and
        (@ModifiedFrom is null or tim.ModifiedOn >= @ModifiedFrom) and
        (@ProjectId is null or prj.Id = @ProjectId) and
        (@ProjectNumber is null or prj.Number = cast(@ProjectNumber as nvarchar))
